documentName: 获取应用中心的隐私详情
content:
# 【应用中心】获取隐私详情

请求地址：[https://ad.e.kuaishou.com/rest/openapi/gw/dsp/appcenter/privacy/detail](https://ad.e.kuaishou.com/rest/openapi/gw/dsp/appcenter/privacy/detail)

请求方式：POST

数据格式：JSON

### 请求参数

| 字段         | 类型   | 示例值   | 是否必填   | 说明   | 备注                        |
| ------------ | ------ | ------ | ------ | ------ | --------------------------- |
| advertiser_id | Long |  | 必填 | 广告主id |
| privacy_id | Long |  | 必填 | 隐私id |  |

### 返回参数

| 字段         | 类型  | 示例   | 说明                        | 备注         |
| ------------ | ------ | ------ | --------------------------- | ---------- |
| code | Integer |  | 返回码 |  |
| message | String |  | 返回详情 |  |
| data | Object |  | JSON 返回值 |  |
|  account_id | Long |  | 账号id |  |
|  privacy_id | Long |  | 隐私id |  |
|  url | String |  | 隐私链接 |  |


### 请求样例

```js
curl --location 'https://ad.e.kuaishou.com/rest/openapi/gw/dsp/appcenter/privacy/detail' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--header 'Access-Token: [REDACTED_SECRET_EXAMPLE]' \
--data '{
    "advertiser_id":900015364,
    "privacy_id":4801146
}'

```

### 返回样例

```
{
    "code": 0,
    "data": {
        "account_id": 900015364,
        "privacy_id": 4801146,
        "url": "https://master--kuaishou-frontend-app-platform.jinx.staging.kuaishou.com/create/android?__accountId__=900015364"
    },
    "message": "OK",
    "request_id": "EPSAgIDwg5mOrAEY_wYgqOC5u_QwKIO19M8E"
}

```
